observations: Photo 0: Front of DSLR body with 'Canon EOS 5D Mark II' embossed, body cap attached, no lens mounted.
Photo 1: Rear view showing LCD screen (appears blank/off, no image to confirm function), Canon logo, control buttons, on/off switch.
Photo 2: Bottom plate with model plate reading 'Canon DS126201', serial number '3761814763', made in Japan, confirming 5D Mark II identity.
No lens, battery, charger, strap, or memory card visible in any photo.
No power-on or live-view shot showing the screen actually displaying an image.
No shot of sensor, lens mount contacts, or shutter curtain.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'CDICSON BUSINESS WORLD' overlay images, consistent with a listing platform, not a red flag by itself.

claims.claim: Canon EOS 5D Mark II, full-frame DSLR, 21.1-megapixel sensor
claims.evidence: Photo 0 front badge and photo 2 model plate confirm this is genuinely a 5D Mark II body; the 21.1MP spec is a known factory spec for this model, not a condition claim.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or the LCD/sensor may be faulty
risks.proof: A photo or short clip of the camera powered on, showing a live image on the LCD or a test shot on the screen

risks.risk: Unknown shutter actuation count (5D Mark II shutters are rated ~150,000 but wear varies)
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from EOS Info or similar utility, or the info screen showing it
risks.if_unproven: priced as high/unknown shutter count, i.e. lower end

risks.risk: No lens, battery, charger, or memory card shown; item may be body-only
risks.proof: Photos of included accessories (lens, battery, charger) laid out together with the body

risks.risk: Sensor dust, scratches, or mirror/mount damage hidden by the body cap
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the sensor and mirror box with the cap off, and the lens mount
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, risk of sensor/mirror issues

risks.risk: Autofocus and image quality cannot be judged from these shots
risks.proof: Sample full-resolution photos taken with the camera, or a short video of AF in action
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified AF/image quality, worst case assumed

proof_requests: Power-on clip showing the LCD displaying a live image or menu
Shutter count screenshot or info screen reading
Clear photo of sensor/mirror box with body cap removed
Photo of all accessories included (lens, battery, charger, strap, card)
Sample photos taken with the camera to confirm image quality
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body via visible badges and the model plate, but no proof of power-on function, shutter count, or included accessories is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as a body-only, untested unit.
